manifest.title: Build anything (any kind of app)
manifest.description: Build whatever the user describes: the interview asks what it is for, who uses it, what it handles and what they do, and the must-haves. Each must-have is proven by a test at the end. Runs on the local base (this computer only), on Firebase, on Cloudflare (published), or on Supabase with its screen on Cloudflare (published).

appName.label: The app's name (a working name is fine)
appName.why: Shown on the screens and in the instructions

idea.label: What do you want to make (in a few words)?
idea.why: It becomes the core of what is built
idea.placeholder: e.g. A recipe-sharing app for the family

problem.label: What problem does it solve?
problem.why: It decides which features are must-haves
problem.placeholder: e.g. Our recipes are scattered across notes and bookmarks, and we cannot find one when we want to cook it

audience.label: Who will use it?
audience.why: It decides sign-in and who can see it

options.家族・友人など少人数: A few people, such as family or friends

things.label: What does it handle? (e.g. books, bookings, stock, recipes)
things.why: These become the tables of data

actions.label: What do the people using it do? (e.g. add, search, book, see totals)
actions.why: These become the API and the screens
actions.placeholder: e.g. add a recipe, search by ingredient, make a shopping list

mustHaves.label: The features it needs from the very start
mustHaves.why: At the end, a test checks each one works
mustHaves.placeholder: e.g. adding and editing recipes, searching by title and ingredient

later.label: Features that can wait
later.why: Left out of the first version
later.placeholder: e.g. automatic photo touch-up, meal suggestions

signIn.label: How should people sign in?
signIn.why: It decides how the app is protected

options.なし（このパソコンからだけ使う）: No sign-in (used only from this computer)

roles.label: Should there be different roles? (e.g. admin and regular user)
roles.why: It becomes the rules for who can do what
roles.placeholder: e.g. An admin can delete any recipe; family members can edit only their own

dataSensitivity.label: The most sensitive information it handles
dataSensitivity.why: It decides how strictly data is stored and backed up

options.公開してよい情報のみ: Only information that may be public
options.身内だけの情報: Information for family or close people only
options.お金や健康など特に機微な情報: Especially sensitive information, such as money or health

references.label: Similar services or the look you have in mind (if any)
references.why: Used as a reference for the screens
references.placeholder: e.g. A list like a recipe site's, with large photos

acceptance@local.title: Prove the must-haves by tests
acceptance@local.description: Each must-have from the interview gets a test that shows it working end to end through the API.

acceptance@cloudflare.title: Prove the must-haves by tests
acceptance@cloudflare.description: Each must-have from the interview gets a test that shows it working end to end through the API.

acceptance@firebase.title: Prove the must-haves by tests
acceptance@firebase.description: Each must-have gets a test against the emulators that walks it end to end as a signed-in user, and is refused for everyone it should be refused for.

acceptance@supabase.title: Prove the must-haves by tests
acceptance@supabase.description: Each must-have gets a test against the local Supabase stack that walks it end to end as the user the spec names, and is refused for everyone it should be refused for.

features.title: Features and screens
features.description: Builds the spec's must-haves as screens and client-side logic, and checks with the emulators that they work inside the Firestore rules.

home-library.title: Home library
home-library.description: A small app to list the books at home and record who you lent them to. No sign-in; it runs on this computer only. A good size for seeing the whole way an app gets built.

mini-sns.title: Mini social network (something like Twitter)
mini-sns.description: Share short posts and read the posts of people you follow on a timeline. Sign in with a Google account; published on Firebase. Shows everything a public app has to get right.

household-budget.title: Household budget
household-budget.description: Record income and spending, and total them by month and by category. Only you use it; it runs on this computer only.

team-taskboard.title: Team task board
team-taskboard.description: Manage the team's tasks in columns: to do, in progress, done. People get in with one shared password; it runs on this computer.

quote-builder.title: Quote maker
quote-builder.description: Enter the client, items, quantities and unit prices to get a quote with consumption tax included. Each is numbered and saved, and can be printed or made into a PDF. It runs on this computer.
